name: GrabLedger
note: LedgerWindow::Grab. First call: new LedgerWindow, RunScript ui/ledger.lua with it as window context, FitToChildren, PrepareInstance (money=display=target, collect droppers, UpdateLedger all), 50 ms anim task. Later calls: detach from parent. Then add to top modal and SetWindowDepth(front). No update is issued; callers follow with UpdateLedger(portview|mapview).

name: ReleaseLedger
note: LedgerWindow::Release. Removes the ledger from its parent if both exist; does not delete it. Must run before the holding modal is destroyed.

name: RealUpdateLedger
kind: native function (registered by LedgerWindow ctor, nil on dtor)
note: Modes (exact): newplayer, all (time+money+rank+factory, plus quest for newplayer only), time, money, rank, quest (questText:=data), factory, portview, mapview. Unknown modes only invalidate. money animates 20 ticks of 50 ms; all numbers float32-rounded. Lua wrapper UpdateLedger(type) computes data.

name: SetLedgerQuestIndicator
kind: native function (registered by LedgerWindow ctor, nil on dtor)
note: on: complete image, no flash. flash: complete image, flash 250 ms phases for 1500 ms then steady complete; sound quest_requirements_met only on transition into flash. anything else: incomplete image. Child ledger_questgoals required. flashQuest starts true in ctor.

name: AnimateProduction
kind: native function (registered by LedgerWindow ctor, nil on dtor)
note: Resets every DookieDropper animation clock to 0. Called at the start of TickSim.

name: UpdateLedger
note: Wrapper: factory covers for factory/newplayer, quest summary data for quest/newplayer (font-size prefix by length), RealUpdateLedger(type,data), then UpdateActiveQuestGoalsComplete.

name: UpdateActiveQuestGoalsComplete
note: Computes off/flash/on from Player:GetPrimaryQuest():AreGoalsMet() and calls SetLedgerQuestIndicator.

name: LedgerUpdateDisplay
note: Referenced under if-guard in Reforged ui_buysell.lua; defined nowhere. Leave undefined.

name: LedgerWindow
note: Created only by GrabLedger; size 0x84; no AddWindowType. Children come from ui/ledger.lua.

name: DookieDropper
args: x,y,w,h,name(=factory name),contents,command,itemx=18,itemy=86,ingredienty=58,barHeight=42,countx=57,county=86; children Text port, Text count
note: Rollover subclass. Update 000211ee reads Player.factories[name].current/production/stall, Player.rank, _AllProducts[current].counts/appearance, draws bars from Player.supply / _weeksPerColumn[rank] (4,6,8,8,8,10,10). Draw 00021ecc. Animate 00020d40 (50 ms steps to 2000).

name: SetMood
note: Character::SetCharacterMood. For every visible Character with that name: frame target by SetMood 000076fa (3 frames: <33.3 -> 1, <66.7 -> 0, else 2; N frames: min(N-1,(int)((N-1)*h/100)+1)); 200 ms cross-fade in 50 ms steps. No-op if none visible.

name: GetState
note: Shipped Lua only uses the no-argument THiscore form: 0 local,1 requesting categories,2 requesting scores,3 submitting,4 global,5 error. Registered by THiscore ctor, cleared by its dtor.

name: ScoreAvailable
note: True iff the current user has a row in the current game-mode local table whose dnq byte is 0 (any freshly logged score).

name: UpdateText
note: Refreshes hiscore rows and panel text. Unused by shipped Lua.

name: SubmissionDone
note: state:=1, request categories, submitState:=qualified?success:DNQ, UpdateText, then runs Lua UpdateButtons().

name: LaunchPrivacyPolicy
note: Opens http://www.playfirst.com/privacypolicy.html. Unused by Lua; no-op.

name: UpdateButtons
note: Called by THiscore::UpdateButtons via DoLuaString; defined in ui/hiscore.lua.

name: LogScore
note: RecordScore: per game-mode table, max 500 rows sorted descending, one row per user (replaced only if higher), competition ranks. Row: rank,score,user,gameData,medals,mode,local=true,dnq=false,guid.

name: GetScore
note: Factory mini-game score so far; registered by the last-constructed factory window. Phase 4.

name: StartGame
note: Resets and starts the factory mini-game; sets states ChocolateFactoryTime=restart, RecycleCount=0. Phase 4.

name: PauseGame
note: Sets Lua global gPauseText=text and fills window information with ui/game_pause.lua. Phase 4.

name: ResumeGame
note: Phase 4.

name: PrepareGame
note: 21 crates; value=(uint)(bet*f+0.5) floored to 100s, min 100 if f>0; f = .435x3,.4,.35x4,.25x4,.24x3,.15,.1,.05,0x3 (sum 5.125); shuffled by 21 swaps with rand()%21.

name: SelectPrize
note: Opens a crate; sounds crate_click, crate_with_money / crate_no_money; whammy_devil image for bombs; final=true reveals without sparkle.

name: StartSlots
note: s1..s4 = 1-based option index per wheel; payout float drives sparkle (gSparkleTime=payout*0.5+1, gSparkleDensity=payout*10; <=0 skips sparkle). 50 ms animation. Calls DSL onstopped when wheels stop and onpayout after sparkle.

name: StopSlots
note: Moves the first still-spinning wheel with state>3 to state 3.

name: RandomDesign
note: Sound randomize, 100 ms animation for 2 s; each tick re-rolls layers 0 (<=1000 ms), 1 (<1501, RandRange(1,n-1)), 2 (<1801, RandRange(2,n-1)), 3, and runs Lua SetRecipeTint(layer,1..100).

name: SetRecipeType
note: Scans custom/<category>/*.png (skipping _highlight) into four layer lists by layer1..layer4 in the name; appends empty entries (beverage: lists 2,4; others 2,3,4).

name: SetLayer
note: index wrapped (index+size)%size; updates option_layerN/option_highlightN/display_layerN/display_highlightN.

name: GetLayerImage
note: Current entry without the leading custom/ (7 chars); empty for none.

name: SetRecipeTint
note: Called by RecipeDesigner animation; defined in ui_kitchen.lua.

name: SetBackground
note: Loads logo/<name> as the sign background.

name: SetLogo
note: Loads logo/<name> as the logo sprite.

name: SetFont
note: Font fonts/<name> for the sign text sprite.

name: SetText
note: Sets the sign text sprite text (not the generic window SetText).

name: BTSetTint
note: Top-modal child lookup, must be BitmapTint; fields [1..4] default 1.0; no invalidate.

name: BTSetOffset
note: Sets offset floats at +0x58,+0x5c of the BitmapTint.

name: BTSetFlip
note: Sets flip byte at +0x68.

name: SetRectangleColor
note: Top-modal child lookup, must be Rectangle; missing fields default 0.0 (alpha 0 hides it); InvalidateScreen.

name: SaveVolumes
kind: native function (TOptions, registered in OptionsWindow ctor, never cleared)
note: Per child slider sfxlevelslider/musiclevelslider/ambientlevelslider: prefs soundlevel/musiclevel/ambientlevel[curuser] = (int)(value*1000), flushed. Defaults 750/650/500.

name: ToggleFullScreen
note: SetFullscreen(!current); on success prefs fullscreen=1/0 (global) and returns true; false on platform failure, no pref change.

name: ToggleSoundMute
note: soundoff[curuser] = (old+1)&1; SetState(kMute,new); BSGSoundMute(QueryMuteGame()).

name: SoundEvent
note: Silent no-op acceptable; never errors on unknown keys.

name: BSGSetSoundLevel
note: Sound manager type volume 1000 and 0, CADI Sfx Volume. Called live by OptionsWindow on slider messages and by SetSoundForCurrentUser.

name: BSGSetMusicLevel
note: Sound manager type 1001, CADI Music Volume.

name: BSGSetAmbientLevel
note: CADI Environments Volume only.

name: BSGSoundMute
note: true: master volume 0 and CADI volumes 0; false: master 1.0 and SetSoundForCurrentUser.

name: QuitToMainMenu
note: Pops modals from the top (PopModal(format %8x id)) until the top modal has no parent. Unused by shipped Lua.

name: StartMovie
note: Empty path false; otherwise TFlashHost on path, true if Start succeeds. Engine: return false (movies skipped) so DisplaySplash shows the still image.

name: IsMoviePlaying
note: True only while a host exists and plays. Engine: false.

name: StopMovie
note: Stops and deletes the host; safe with none.

name: SubmitToServer
args: (string name, string account, string pass, bool remember, bool medalsOnly)
note: Empty pass: store pref _anonusername=name, submit anonymously; else submit with account/pass. Then Lua SwitchModes(true) and 20 ms animation that polls the request and sets gReturnValue='success'|'qualified' and pops the modal, or shows submiterror. Offline: no-op that calls SwitchModes(false).

name: GetLuaServerSubmitSetupVars
note: gNameEdit='<_anonusername>'; then gAccountEdit/gPassEdit/gRemember (remembered login or empty,false); then gMedalsMode=true; or gMedalsMode=false;gEligibleScore=<eligible local score or 0>.

name: SwitchModes
note: Called by TServerSubmit via DoLuaString as SwitchModes(true|false); defined in ui/serversubmit.lua.

name: SubmitWindow
args: base TWindow keys; children nameedit, accountedit, submittoserver, submitconnect, submiterror, submiterrorok
note: TServerSubmit. Registered by TServerSubmit::Register with AddWindowType.

name: GetTopModalWindow
note: Only used by CloseAllModals in Reforged helpers.lua, which nothing calls. Leave unregistered.

name: SaveCreationToFile
note: Only used by ui_kitchen.lua SaveCreation(), which nothing calls. Leave unregistered or logged no-op.

name: RankNames
note: Guarded by `RankNames and ...` in community_scores_results.lua; nothing defines it. Rank names are string keys rank_1..rank_5.

name: _SetState
note: TGameState::SetState. Key prefix ++ increments. Key kMute toggles master volume 0 / restore. Dead in shipped Lua (SetState calls are commented FIRST PEEK).

name: QueryMuteGame
note: Any handler, else to_int(GetState(kMute)) != 0.

name: QueryRestartMode
note: Polls handlers; false without any.

name: QueryJumpToMenu
note: Polls handlers; false without any.
